onlyOwner configuration function registering an input token and its input/output rates for id < 3
receive() external payable, accepts plain ETH transfers into the contract

onlyOwner function that writes per-account balances and grows totalDevidend

msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization, balances and payout recipients
External ERC20 call tokenAccel.transfer(msg.sender, balanceOf(this)) inside ownerWithdrawEthAndToken
Native ETH send payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance) inside ownerWithdrawEthAndToken
External ERC20 call tokenAccel.transfer(msg.sender, tokens) inside claim (interacts with arbitrary token code)
Native ETH send payable(msg.sender).transfer(eth) inside claim, executed before totalDevidend is decremented
State write balances[id][accounts[i]] = amount[i] in ownerSetupTokenBalance loop without length validation
totalDevidend = totalDevidend.add(amount.mul(rateOutput).div(rateInput)) arithmetic in ownerSetupTokenBalance (division by rateInput may be zero)
totalDevidend = totalDevidend - dividend subtraction executed after external transfers in claim
yourDividend accumulation with mul/div over balances and tokenInput rates in getClaimableAmount
State write claimed[msg.sender] = true in claim (replay protection flag)

normalization_plan.reason: Token slot id is only meaningful as input to the owner-only token configuration function (and its twin ownerSetupTokenBalance)
_inputToken is written straight into tokenInput[id].addr by the configuration function
_inputRate sets tokenInput[id].rateInput used as divisor in payout math
_outputRate sets tokenInput[id].rateOutput used as multiplier in payout math
accounts array is only consumed by the balance setup loop
amount array is only consumed by the balance setup loop
account parameter is only used to index balances in the claimable-amount view
newOwner is only used to overwrite _owner in the ownership transfer
yourDividend is the accumulator of the unchecked pro-rata arithmetic in getClaimableAmount
tokens is the amount handed to the external ERC20 transfer in claim
eth is the amount handed to the native ETH transfer in claim
dividend is the value subtracted from totalDevidend after the external calls
loop index i drives every storage write of balances[id][accounts[i]]
msgSender local is only used to seed _owner during construction
